title: GalaxEye Launches 'Mission Drishti' — World's 1st OptoSAR Hybrid EO Satellite
summary: Bengaluru space startup GalaxEye launches 190kg Mission Drishti aboard SpaceX Falcon 9, combining optical and SAR sensors on one platform.

blocks.text: 🪝 GalaxEye Launches 'Mission Drishti' — World's 1st OptoSAR Hybrid EO Satellite. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Space startup GalaxEye launched **Mission Drishti** on a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket, becoming the world's 1st satellite to integrate Electro-Optical (EO) and Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) sensors into a single 190kg platform.
